english.toefl: 5.0 for tests on or after January 21, 2026; 92 for earlier tests
english.note: Graduate School standards; qualifying English-language education can satisfy the requirement. Lower scores may be admitted for in-person programs with program approval and an arrival English assessment. Scores must be within two years of enrollment.

applicationFee.note: International applicants pay an additional $6 processing fee. Program waivers are offered; international applicants should confirm program eligibility. Graduate School fee grants are restricted to U.S. citizens/permanent residents.

documents: Personal statement including research interests and prospective faculty advisors
Unofficial transcripts from all undergraduate and graduate schools attended
requirements.note: Contact potential faculty advisors early; admission depends on acceptance by an individual faculty advisor.

funding.note: Qualified students may receive teaching or research assistantships and fellowships. Appointments of at least 33% during fall/spring qualify for full tuition remission; segregated fees normally remain payable.
